item.title: Existing reminders follow model upgrades
item.summary: Reminders and automations saved with GPT-5.6 Luna, Sol, or Terra now use their GPT-6 replacements when they run on OpenAI.
item.details: Luna moves to GPT-6 Luna; Sol and Terra move to GPT-6 Sol. Schedules and explicit reasoning settings stay intact, with no need to recreate reminders. Venice and custom-provider selections keep their existing behavior.
